title: Destruction of a city led into idolatry
description: Moses gives the procedure for when the inhabitants of an Israelite city are led by wicked men to serve other gods: the case must be investigated and examined carefully, and if it is true, the city's inhabitants and livestock shall be struck with the sword. The city and all its spoil shall be burned as a burnt offering to the Lord and become a ruin heap forever. Nothing of what is banned shall be kept, so that the Lord may turn from His wrath and show mercy.
